title: Portal: Packages
summary: Account → Packages in Polaris Locker, as one card: every package Mara Fennick can install, grouped by the license that gives it (DJDL, Diceroll); her personal tokens, one per computer or build server, with Create personal token; and the setup, 'pkey feeds setup --write' first, then one by-hand setup across both products that names PKEY_REGISTRY_TOKEN.
compare: 2026-10-20 shell (PX-35, BR-lockups): Polaris Locker, not Polaris Key (data-brand="locker", the trimmed outlined Locker lockup, no Key mark, no key.plrs.im footer); no header Activate (the account menu's first item); no footer (Help and Privacy are in the account menu); the docked Library · Discover phone bar, neither tab current on Account; US dates. Reconciled with the built Account → Packages (PackagesCard.tsx, F-33): the build's words ('personal token', PKEY_REGISTRY_TOKEN), one card for the section, token rows, the inline revoke and the expiry choice.

Frame (AccountPage.tsx): h1 'Account' with Sign out on its line and no subtitle (the email is in Profile since PX-31a; the PX-35 baselines predate that and still show 'Name · email'). Sections: Profile · Sign-in methods · Connected apps · Packages · Where you're signed in · Appearance · Your data; Connected apps waits for I-34 (PX-31b). The side nav from 1280 px, the pill row below it, phone included (no section picker). Drawn scrolled to Packages (#/account/packages); the sections above are portal.account's.

One card for the section (build): 'Packages', with the build's line 'A personal token is one read-only credential that installs every package your licenses include.' Its groups: You can install, Your personal tokens, Set up. The section shows only when the account has a feed or a token.

You can install: one table grouped by product (a group row with the logo and the license, 'DJDL · Standard license'), each package in mono with one line, its ecosystem and its stable version; a Public feed's package says 'Also on PyPI.org'. Feeds the person can't read and Polaris Key's own SDKs never appear. Build follow-up: the build has no package list (it needs a per-person package read, F-33's serve-time filtering).

Your personal tokens (build): a row per token, the name, 'pkeyp_…7Q2M', then 'Last used 2 hr. ago · Expires Jan 5, 2027' ('Never used' before first use; inside 14 days a warning 'Expires in 9 days' pill with the clock glyph), and an outlined Revoke named for the token. More than five rows fold behind 'Show all 7'. Create personal token is the section's one primary (packages.portal-token-create); at the limit it is disabled with its reason. The old table with a 'made Oct 7' column is gone, so F-33's named 'token table' follow-up is withdrawn.
Each token row leads with the 40 px key tile, like the page's sign-in method and session rows (kit .account-card). Build follow-up (minor): the build's token rows have no media.
Revoke confirms in the row (packages.portal-token-revoke), not in a dialog (build; F-33's 'mockups to adopt').

Set up leads with 'pkey feeds setup --write' (Copy), then 'Copy the npx command' and the CLI docs, then 'Or by hand': one tabbed block across every product (npm and pnpm, Yarn Berry, Bun, uv, pip, Docker; the build's client names), the npm file routing both scopes, each with its auth line, as the feed renderer writes them; its foot says 'Set PKEY_REGISTRY_TOKEN to one of your personal tokens.' (the build's line). Build follow-up (F-37): the build has no '--write' command or npx line and sets up one product and one package type at a time (App and Package type choices).
Build follow-up (minor): the build draws a 36 px Package glyph tile before the card's title; no other Account card has one, so the mockup leaves it out.

Conditional groups drawn nowhere here: 'Per-app tokens' (pkeyr_ tokens made for one app before personal tokens, and Godot editor URLs; revocable, never minted again) and a Godot-only account's 'Create Godot editor URL'.
Words: license (US), Packages, personal token; never 'packages token', 'registry token', 'feed token', 'grant' or 'capability'.

Phone: the pills scroll under a fade; each package row puts its ecosystem and version under the description; a token's Revoke drops under its text; the code tabs scroll under a fade that ends before Copy.

Checks: no sideways scroll from 320 to 2560 px; axe 0 violations at 390, 1024, 1440 and 1920 in both themes. check.mjs's B17 audit expects a service accent on focus and selection, which Locker draws in neutral ink by design (D9a); it fails every Locker screen (portal.library-menu too) and is not a finding here.
Portal v2 (B2, B12): the docked header, the one filled primary is ink, the page h1 at the display step (48/52, 32/36 on a phone) with no full stop or eyebrow, no glow or wash; weights 400/500/600.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fixed: the setup copy matches the CLI, the page says how to get pkey, and the token model (one per machine, never replaced) is visible.

findings.issue: [Copy says something that doesn't happen] The console card, the portal and the CLI each list different package managers for 'pkey feeds setup --write'; the portal promises pip settings the CLI says it does not write.
findings.resolution: The CLI run is the reference (npm and pnpm, Yarn, Bun, uv and pip credentials in ~/.netrc, Docker; pip's index not written; Swift and Gradle only when a feed has something to install). The console card now says the command 'sets up every package manager DJDL's feeds use'; the portal says it 'sets up npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, uv, pip and Docker in your home folder. pip's index is added per project.', which is what the run writes for Mara's feeds.

findings.issue: [Flow] The recommended 'pkey feeds setup --write' assumes the customer has the pkey CLI; nothing says how to get it.
findings.resolution: Under the command: 'Don't have pkey? With Node 22, npx runs it once without installing it.' with 'Copy the npx command' and 'Docs: the pkey CLI'. Declined the Homebrew line: there is no Homebrew tap; the CLI ships on the pkg.plrs.im npm feed and as an image (packages/cli/README.md), so the copied command is the scoped npx line from SETUP.md §3.3, never a bare npx that would resolve against npmjs.

findings.issue: [Flow] 'Your packages token' (singular) with one row and a 'Create token' primary: creating might replace the laptop's token or add a second; the dialog's 'Work laptop' label implies a second.
findings.resolution: The section is 'Your packages tokens' and lists every token (pkey feeds setup on mara-mbp, Build server); its subtitle says 'A new token never replaces another, and each is shown once'. Create token opens the label step (packages.portal-token-create), which says 'Your other tokens keep working'. Only a CLI rerun on the same machine replaces the token it made there (packages.feeds-setup).

findings.issue: [Copy/visual] 'Read and write Read and write DJDL crates'; djdl-crates is a Public feed under 'With your Standard license'; Revoke has no confirmation; on phone the Docker tab is clipped under Copy ('Dc'); Sign out sits lower than the H1.
findings.resolution: Duplicate fixed ('Read and write DJDL crates'). The djdl-crates row says 'Public, also on PyPI.org'. Revoke opens packages.portal-token-revoke ('Package installs on mara-mbp stop…', naming the token that keeps working). On phone the code tabs scroll under a fade that ends before Copy, so Docker shows as a fading tab. Sign out lines up with the H1.

findings.issue: Three intro lines restate their card titles; the table has an Ecosystem column plus a sub-line saying the same.
findings.resolution: Packages sub-line removed; tokens 'Each token is shown once.'; setup 'In your home folder, never a repository.'; setup explanations merged into one line and the npx hint is a right-aligned link row; 'Also on PyPI.org' is a badge in the Ecosystem cell; Package/Ecosystem column gap closed; Revoke is 36px with a 44px tap target (.tap-44).

findings.issue: [Phone] Code blocks, terminals and tab strips are silently clipped with no scroll cue; 'also required' cuts Info.plist and Docker.
findings.resolution: Kit: .fade-x (edge fade, tabindex 0, role region) and .wrap-phone (soft wrap at 12px on phone) on every code block and terminal; 'also required' is a dot. Gutters (16 phone, 24 up) and card padding (16 phone, 24 up) were already the kit's.
